# Bounded carrier and independent frame result

A private static generic method accepts invariant Carrier<T,V> with V bounded
by a declared class. A callback consumes a fixed Long and produces a third
independent formal R, which the completion consumes. Frozen callers verify the
same-owner private entry, original carrier read, context/callback/completion
order, wide values, nulls, sentinels, deferred captures and exception identity.
Full compiler entries and metadata stay intact. Owned and SDK configurations
run 64 cases twice before and after recovery; four wrong programs must fail.
